description: One Zzorp scan result. Written in the OpenAPI subset that Gemini structured output accepts (type, properties, required, enum, nullable, items).

scan_type.description: first_scan = a new object or place. follow_up = the player is returning with evidence for an open mission.

people_in_frame.description: True if a person is visible. If true, Zzorp ignores the person completely and says nothing about them.

visible_facts.description: Only what can be directly seen. No interpretation. Example: 'a paper cup with a plastic lid on a bench'.

inferences.description: Interpretations Zzorp is making from the visible facts, each phrased as a possibility ('it may have been left behind').

signal_type.description: Zzorp's honest classification. no_signal and insufficient_evidence are good, valid answers.

signal_summary.description: One sentence naming the contradiction, the positive behaviour, or why there is no signal.

evidence_used.description: Archive ids returned by lookup_evidence that this response relies on (e.g. 'EV-002'). An empty list is allowed and expected when no archive fact applies.

missing_information.description: What cannot be determined safely from the image.

zzorp_reaction.description: Zzorp's in-character line. Maximum 2 short sentences. Curious, puzzled or amused; never scolding.

mission.description: Null only when signal_type is no_signal and nothing is worth investigating.

instruction.description: One concrete physical action a child can do, in under 20 words.

photo_to_bring_back.description: What the follow-up photo should show (e.g. 'the bottom of the cup', 'the label on the bin').

ask_an_adult.description: True if the mission needs an adult (a website, a building, anything beyond what the child can see and reach).

entry_title.description: Short title in Zzorp's voice, e.g. 'Specimen #3: The Eight-Minute Cup'.

entry_state.description: Zzorp never sets player_concluded itself; only the app does, after the player writes their conclusion.

zzorp_question.description: The open question the investigation is trying to answer.

new_evidence.description: On follow_up scans: what the new photo showed. Null on first scans.

player_conclusion.description: Always null in Zzorp's output. Filled in by the app from the player's own words.
